title: Forearm Stroking
summary: Gentle longitudinal passes over the forearm from the wrist toward the elbow.
startingPosition: The arm rests on support and the hand is relaxed.
instructions: Place the palm above the wrist.
direction: From the wrist toward the elbow over soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
